screenLevelIssues.explanation: The Figma design shows the main content container (node 1:28061) is pushed to the bottom of the screen, sitting just above the home indicator. It has a fixed height of 613px. Within this container, the text and button sections are pushed to the top and bottom respectively using `justifyContent: 'space-between'`. The current implementation probably uses a simpler flex layout like `justifyContent: 'center'` which fails to replicate this specific alignment and sizing, causing all content to be misplaced vertically.

screenLevelIssues.figmaValue: Multiple background images (a texture and a gradient overlay) are positioned absolutely behind all other UI content.
screenLevelIssues.currentValue: The background images are likely rendered within the standard component flow, which would incorrectly push the UI content down instead of serving as a backdrop.
screenLevelIssues.explanation: The screen design is composed of multiple layers: a base background color, a low-opacity texture image (node 237:2727), and a gradient shape at the top (node 1:28057). These elements must be taken out of the normal layout flow using `position: 'absolute'` and rendered before the main content (or using `zIndex`) to ensure they appear behind the logo, text, and buttons.
